title: Creative Direction
description: Payload shape for the Creative Direction artifact, artifact-contracts.md section 5.10: 'Author the Design Intent Statement; produce creative rationale, positioning read, brand personality and maturity assessment per this business.' Produced by the Creative Director; consumed by the Creative Director for blueprint authoring and by the Composition Designer. Composed with the shared envelope (_common/artifact-envelope.schema.json), which carries artifactId, artifactType, projectId, artifactVersion, versionStatus, owningPhase, producer, executingRole, criticIteration, factoryVersion, registryVersions, and consumedArtifactVersions. This document defines the payload only, per schema-architecture.md section 2. A schema is a shape, never a rule: it does not decide what happens when the shape is violated (schema-architecture.md section 5.1).
$comment: Field set is exactly artifact-contracts.md section 5.10's 'Required information' row: Design Intent Statement (authored here); creative rationale; positioning drawn from business intelligence; brand personality and maturity assessment per this business; exact versions consumed. The Design Intent Statement is authoritative in this artifact per section 5.10 and section 6 invariant 7: the Design Blueprint consumes it by reference and does not re-author it. There is exactly one authored instance per project. This is NOT a separate artifact and NOT a separate schema file.
$comment_envelopeFieldsNotDuplicated: The envelope already owns: artifactType, projectId, artifactVersion, versionStatus, owningPhase, producer, executingRole, criticIteration, factoryVersion, registryVersions, consumedArtifactVersions. These fields are NOT duplicated in the Creative Direction payload below. They are inherited via allOf from _common/artifact-envelope.schema.json and constrained where necessary (artifactType pinned to CREATIVE_DIRECTION, registryVersions and consumedArtifactVersions required for this artifact type per artifact-contracts.md section 7 'Applies to' table).
$comment_compositionPlanNotIncluded: The Composition Plan is a SEPARATE ARTIFACT embedded in the Design Blueprint (artifact-contracts.md section 5.11), NOT part of Creative Direction. It does NOT appear in this schema. The Composition Plan has no independent version or status per section 5.11; it is produced by the Composition Designer using Phase 3 vocabulary and consumed by the Creative Director for blueprint integration.
$comment_phase4Boundary: Phase 4 owns design language SELECTION and per-project parameter VALUES (04-ai-creative-direction.md section 39.1), not the design language or parameter DEFINITIONS. Design languages DL-01 through DL-05 are Phase 2-owned and registered in design-language-registry.md. Parameters with registry entries (creativeIntensity, visualTension, contentDensity, brandMaturity) are cross-phase constructs; this artifact records the Creative Director's per-project value assignment. Parameters WITHOUT registry entries (creativeRisk, imageDominance, typographyDominance) are document-local to Phase 4 per parameter-registry.md decision 20 and Phase 4 sections 19.1, 22.3.

designIntentStatement.description: The Design Intent Statement: a 2-3 sentence articulation of this business's creative point of view, per 04-ai-creative-direction.md section 10. This is the authoritative statement authored in this artifact, per artifact-contracts.md section 5.10 and section 6 invariant 7. The Design Blueprint (section 5.5) consumes it by reference and does not re-author it.

creativeRationale.description: Creative rationale for the direction taken, per artifact-contracts.md section 5.10.

brandPersonality.description: Brand personality matrix: eight dimensions scored 1-10 per Phase 4 section 11.
brandPersonality.$comment: Phase 4 section 11 explicitly states: 'Rate the brand on eight personality dimensions (1–10)' — this is an explicit scale declaration. The eight dimension names are preserved exactly as written.

brandMaturity.description: Brand maturity classification per Phase 4 section 12. CONFLICT PRESERVED: Phase 4 uses 4-level scale (Weak/Developing/Established/Strong), registry defines 3 values (Weak/Developing/Mature). Scale conflict recorded in parameter-registry.md section 7 issue 14. NOT RESOLVED.
brandMaturity.$comment: GAP / CONFLICT PRESERVED - Phase 4 section 12.1 explicitly records the unresolved scale conflict. Left untyped (no enum, no integer) rather than inventing a resolution.

assetCapability.description: Asset capability scores per Phase 4 section 13.2. Four scores on explicit 0-10 range.
assetCapability.$comment: Phase 4 section 13.2 explicitly declares 0–10 range. This is the ONLY Phase 4 construct with a 0-floor rather than 1-floor.

primaryLanguage.description: Primary design language selection per Phase 4 section 17. Must be one of the five Phase 2-registered design languages. Locked for V1 per design-language-registry.md section 1.

designLanguage.description: Design language selection per Phase 4 sections 16-17. Phase 4 owns the SELECTION; Phase 2 owns the design language definitions.
designLanguage.$comment: The five design language IDs are exactly the set registered in design-language-registry.md section 3.1 and locked for V1 per section 1.

creativeIntensity.description: Creative intensity score, 1-10 per Phase 4 section 18.

creativeRisk.description: Creative risk per Phase 4 section 19: separated from intensity to allow high intensity while keeping risk low.
creativeRisk.$comment: GAP / NOT REGISTERED - Phase 4 section 19.1: 'creativeRisk has no Parameter Registry entry' and 'no declared scale'. Left untyped rather than inventing a scale.

visualTension.description: Visual tension score, 1-10 per Phase 4 section 20.

contentDensity.description: Content density level per Phase 4 section 21.

imageDominance.description: Image dominance score, 1-10 per Phase 4 section 22.1.
imageDominance.$comment: NOT REGISTERED - Phase 4 section 22.3: 'imageDominance appears in parameter-registry.md' is FALSE. Document-local to Phase 4 per decision 20.

typographyDominance.description: Typography dominance score, 1-10 per Phase 4 section 22.2.
typographyDominance.$comment: NOT REGISTERED - Phase 4 section 22.3 confirms no registry entry. Not a strict inverse of imageDominance per section 22.2.

parameters.description: Per-project parameter values per Phase 4 sections 18-22.
parameters.$comment: creativeIntensity, visualTension, contentDensity are REQUIRED (core strategic decisions with registry entries). creativeRisk, imageDominance, typographyDominance are OPTIONAL (document-local, no registry entries).
